validation_driver_source:
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess,tarfile,time
E=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
W=Path('/home/deck/.local/state/rog5-review-correctness-20260912-r1')
U=Path('/home/deck/.local/state/rog5-denial-20260910-r1/upstream-audit-r1/source')
S=Path('/home/deck/.local/state/rog5-focus-trace-20260913-r1/fix-r1/source')
BASE='85b2303e2f09ae7b7b993641f90061a200f03d53'
runtime='/home/deck/.local/state/rog5-xwayland-runtime-evidence-20260912-r1/materialize/root'
image='0f429c6fd38e4400d8638bff1f7da0170375275ab29201e327a3e236ed9df16d'
archive=E/'payload-r1/session.tar.gz'
receipt=json.loads((E/'payload-r1/provenance.json').read_text())
started=time.monotonic()
with archive.open('rb') as f: assert hashlib.file_digest(f,'sha256').hexdigest()==receipt['sha256']
with tarfile.open(archive,'r:gz') as tar:
    manifest=json.load(tar.extractfile('usr/share/rog5-denial/payload.json'))
    assert manifest==receipt['metadata']
    for row in manifest['files']:
        info=tar.getmember(row['name'])
        assert info.isfile() and info.uid==info.gid==info.mtime==0
        assert info.mode==row['mode'] and info.size==row['size']
        with tar.extractfile(info) as f: assert hashlib.file_digest(f,'sha256').hexdigest()==row['sha256']
    for name in ('usr/bin/deniald','usr/bin/denialctl'):
        h=tar.extractfile(name).read(20)
        assert h[:5]==b'\x7fELF\x02' and h[5]==1 and h[18:20]==b'\xb7\x00'
checks=[]
for path in ('compositor/src/bin/denialctl.rs','compositor/src/lib.rs','compositor/Cargo.lock'):
    data=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(U),'show',BASE+':'+path],timeout=10)
    assert (S/path).read_bytes()==data,path
    checks.append({'path':path,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'unchanged':True})
name='rog5-session-payload-cli-r1'
commands=[['qemu-aarch64','-L','/runtime','/work/usr/bin/denialctl','--help'],
          ['qemu-aarch64','-L','/runtime','/work/usr/bin/denialctl','--version'],
          ['qemu-aarch64','-L','/runtime','/work/usr/bin/deniald','--help']]
shell='set -eu\ntar -xzf /payload/session.tar.gz -C /work usr/bin/deniald usr/bin/denialctl\n'
shell+='\n'.join(' '.join(c) for c in commands)
cmd=['podman','run','--name',name,'--pull=never','--rm','--network=none','--read-only','--memory=256m','--memory-swap=256m','--cpus=1','--pids-limit=64','--tmpfs','/work:rw,size=32m',
     '-v',str(archive.parent)+':/payload:ro','-v',runtime+':/runtime:ro',image,'/bin/sh','-c',shell]
result={'scope':'archive bytes, ARM64 ELF and qemu-user CLI only; no DRM or session execution',
        'archive_sha256':receipt['sha256'],'command':cmd,'cli_commands':commands,'source_compatibility':checks,
        'phone_operations':False,'physical':'NOT RUN'}
try:
    with (E/'cli.log').open('xb') as log:
        r=subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=45)
    result['exit_status']=r.returncode
finally:
    subprocess.run(['podman','rm','--force',name],capture_output=True,timeout=15)
    result['container_removed']=subprocess.run(['podman','container','exists',name],capture_output=True,timeout=10).returncode==1
    result['duration_seconds']=time.monotonic()-started
    result['status']='PASS' if result.get('exit_status')==0 and result['container_removed'] else 'FAIL'
    (E/'validation-result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
assert result['status']=='PASS'
